description:
Plan C deferred from JMAP-sc1b.9. Once JMAP-sc1b.10 (deny.toml) is configured, add a 'deny' job to .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs 'cargo deny check' on every push.

Implementation hint: use the EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action@v2 action — handles install + invocation in one step. Or install cargo-deny via 'cargo install cargo-deny --locked' and run 'cargo deny check'.

Blocked by: JMAP-sc1b.10 (deny.toml configuration). Without a deny.toml the action defaults are too strict for this workspace (license check would fire on existing transitive deps).

Closes the deny TODO comment in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
